transcripts.transcript: I saw the 72 year old patient today for follow-up of his type 2 diabetes. His patient ID is 482019376. Since his last visit we reduced his evening glargine from 40 units to 32 units after several low readings overnight, and he has stayed on metformin 1000 milligrams twice a day. His fasting glucose readings this week have been between 110 and 140, which is an improvement. He reports no dizziness or night sweats. His feet show no new sores, and sensation is intact. I spoke with his daughter Maria by phone, and she confirms he is taking his medications as prescribed. We will repeat his A1c in three months and continue the current plan.
